metadata.question: On August 3, 2025, were there more than 30 fires active in Manitoba, Canada?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Collection: MODIS active-fire product “MODIS/006/MOD14A1” (daily 1-km fire mask) or the FIRMS VIIRS active-fire dataset (“FIRMS”). Both report active fires per day; MODIS is fine for a Yes/No threshold. - Date: 2025-08-03. - Location: Manitoba province. Build a rough bounding box about 49–60°N, –102 to –94°W (entirely covers Manitoba and keeps the region small enough for fast counting). 2. Masking strategy. - Active-fire mask band ‘MaxFRP’ (or ‘FireMask’) flags fire pixels. We simply count pixels whose fire mask = 7–9 (high-confidence fire) or MaxFRP > 0. No cloud masking needed—this product is already daily cloud-screened. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - Count the number of qualifying pixels inside the Manitoba box. - If the image collection for 2025-08-03 is size 0 → C1. - If after masking there are 0 qualifying pixels, that is a valid zero (answer = B). - If reducer returns None/NaN → C3. - Else compare pixel count to 30: >30 ⇒ A, ≤30 ⇒ B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time mb = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-102, 49, -94, 60]) # covers Manitoba date = '2025-08-03' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') \ .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \ .filterBounds(mb) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No MODIS image for 2025-08-03.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Processing: mask high-confidence fire pixels img = col.first() fire = img.select('MaxFRP').gt(0) # alternative: ('FireMask').gte(7) count = fire.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=mb, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('MaxFRP').getInfo() # 4. Validation & Answer if count is None: print("Fire count is None.") print("C3") else: print(f"Active fire pixels: {int(count)}") print("A" if count > 30 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
mb = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-102, 49, -94, 60])  # covers Manitoba
date = '2025-08-03'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') \
        .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
        .filterBounds(mb)
n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No MODIS image for 2025-08-03.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing: mask high-confidence fire pixels
img = col.first()
fire = img.select('MaxFRP').gt(0)  # alternative: ('FireMask').gte(7)
count = fire.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=mb,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('MaxFRP').getInfo()

# 4. Validation & Answer
if count is None:
    print("Fire count is None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Active fire pixels: {int(count)}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if count > 30 else "<answer>B</answer>")
